### Version Progression Concerns

- **gaze**: v0.1.0 → v1.0.0 in 4 days (Feb 24 → Feb 28) [14]. Reaching
  "stable" 1.0 in 4 days is unusual by SemVer conventions [24].
- **dewey**: Three major versions in 14 days (v1.0.0 Mar 28, v2.0.0 Apr 7,
  v3.0.0 Apr 11) [14]. Each major version implies breaking API changes per
  SemVer [24]. Three breaking changes in two weeks signals API instability.
- **replicator/unbound-force**: Still at 0.x, which per SemVer means
  "anything may change at any time" and "the public API should not be
  considered stable" [24].
